description: A party organizer needs to transport party goers either by limousine or bus. Limousines can carry 12 people and buses can carry 18 people. They need to transport at least 400 people. Because limousines are more attractive, at least 70% of the vehicles must be limousines. How many of each type of vehicle should be used to minimize the total number of limousines and buses used?

LimousineCapacity.definition: Number of people a limousine can carry

BusCapacity.definition: Number of people a bus can carry

MinPeople.definition: Minimum number of people to transport

MinLimousineFraction.definition: Minimum fraction of vehicles that must be limousines

objective.description: "Minimize the total number of vehicles used (the sum of limousines and buses)"

constraints.description: 12 * (number of limousines) + 18 * (number of buses) must be at least 400
3 * (number of limousines) must be at least 7 * (number of buses)
Number of limousines and number of buses must be non-negative integers

numLimousines.definition: Number of limousines used to transport people

numBuses.definition: Number of buses used to transport people
